mapper.select: SELECT a.*, u.real_name AS user_name, q.title AS questionnaire_title FROM assessment a LEFT JOIN users u ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN questionnaire q ON a.questionnaire_id = q.id WHERE a.id = #{id}
